title: 第十九章：一碗冷粥的羞辱
lines: 最后，是镇北王旧伤复查时，出现短暂“心脉逆震”。
把一个名字，慢慢推到了风口浪尖。
几名太医围坐一圈，神色凝重。
每一份，都写着同一个结论：
“她的处理方式，已经超出医理。”
“你这是在夸她，还是在说她胡来？”
“我是在说——她的手法，不属于我们这一脉。”
content_zh:
暴雨如注，整整肆虐了一整夜，直至天亮时分，依旧没有停歇的迹象。

    祠堂外，寒风凛冽，如刀割般刺骨。沈知微已然在这冰冷的蒲团上跪了整整两日，她的膝盖早已麻木得失去了知觉，脸色苍白如纸，没有一丝血色，仿佛一尊毫无生气的雕像。然而，她依旧顽强地支撑着，没有倒下。因为她心里清楚，此刻绝不能示弱，一旦倒下，侯府那些心怀叵测之人，定会更加变本加厉地欺负她。

    可人的身体终究不是钢铁铸就，刚一站起身，眼前便猛地一阵发黑，整个人不由自主地踉跄了一下。

    “姑娘！” 春桃眼疾手快，急忙上前扶住她。手刚触碰到沈知微的额头，便吓得惊呼出声：“好烫！姑娘，您发烧了！”

    青禾见状，也慌了神，急忙说道：“奴婢马上去请大夫。”

    然而，她刚跑出去没多久，便红着眼眶折返回来。

    “姑娘…… 府医不肯来。”

    “轰” 的一声，春桃顿时气得双眼通红，怒问道：“为什么？”

    青禾紧紧咬着嘴唇，声音带着一丝哽咽说道：“夫人说…… 大小姐正在受罚，任何人不得擅自帮忙。”

    空气瞬间凝固，沈知微却并未流露出丝毫意外之色。这才是苏氏真正的手段，既不打骂，却通过隔绝一切帮助，一点一点地将她困在绝境之中。

    就在这时，门口传来一阵脚步声，一个婆子端着一碗粥缓缓走了进来。

    “大小姐，夫人心疼您，特意吩咐厨房给您送来的。”

    春桃赶忙接过，可下一秒，脸色瞬间变得极为难看。只见碗里的粥稀得几乎能照见人影，而且已然冰凉，上面还漂浮着几粒碎米。

    “轰” 的一下，青禾气得浑身颤抖，愤怒地说道：“这哪里是人吃的东西？连下人都吃得比这好！”

    婆子却只是冷笑一声，说道：“大小姐正在受罚，有口吃的就已经很不错了。” 说完，便转身扬长而去。

    春桃气得泪水夺眶而出，哭喊道：“姑娘，她们实在是欺人太甚了！奴婢去找侯爷评理！”

    沈知微却缓缓摇了摇头，说道：“不去。”

    春桃愣住了，一脸疑惑地问道：“为什么？”

    沈知微轻轻望向那碗冷粥，忽然微微一笑，说道：“因为，她终于开始着急了。”
content_en:
Something happened in the palace.

    Not one piece.

    They come out in succession.

    First, there was the "red rash case" at the pharmacy banquet.

    Then there is the "accidental poisoning case" in the side hall.

    Finally, when Zhenbei Wang was undergoing a review of his old injury, he experienced a brief "heart shock".

    Three things stacked together.

    Like an invisible line.

    Slowly pushing a name to the forefront.

    ——Su Wan.

    Too hospital, late at night.

    The candle flickered.

    Several imperial doctors sat in a circle with solemn expressions.

    There are three files on the table.

    Each copy contains the same conclusion:

    "Inexplicable."

    "She is no ordinary healer."

    An old doctor spoke in a low voice.

    "The way she dealt with it went beyond medical principles."

    Another person frowned:

    "What do you mean?"

    The old doctor was silent for a moment.

    "She's not treating a disease."

    "It's 'reconstructing pathology'."

    There was silence in the room.

    Someone sneered:

    "Are you praising her, or are you calling her nonsense?"

    The old doctor shook his head.

    "No."

    He raised his eyes.

    "What I'm saying is that her methods don't belong to our lineage."

    The air slowly sank.

    Someone opened the file.

    "What do you think about the case of King Zhenbei?"

    An imperial doctor said in a low voice:

    "Heart pulse reversal."

    "Acupuncture is not 'unblocking', it is 'changing flow'."

    Another person frowned:

    "That's impossible."

    "The human body is not an organ."

    The old doctor said slowly:

    “What if someone thought of the human body as a ‘system’?”

    The room fell silent for a moment.

    "System..."

    Someone murmured and repeated.

    This word rarely appears in medical science.

    But in all Su Wan's records, it was mentioned secretly more and more frequently.

    Another young imperial physician suddenly spoke:

    "One more thing."

    Everyone looked at him.

    He turned to another page of records.

    "Those incidents in the Prime Minister's Mansion."

    "Every time, she was able to intervene at the 'most critical point'."

    He looked up.

    "Too accurate."

    "It's so precise that it doesn't look like medical skill."

    "Like prediction."

    The atmosphere in the room completely changed.

    Someone whispered:

    "You mean, she's manipulative?"

    The young imperial doctor shook his head:

    "No."

    "It's her who's 'calculating'."
title_en: Chapter 18 Kneeling in the temple on a rainy night for three days
